content: .{@-अतिदेशः@} Extension (of gender, number <ab>&c.</ab>) to the objects (as against words), {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} to treat a single object as though it were many, a female as though it were male. (तन्त्रवार्त्तिक <ls n="tantravārttika">1. 2. 58. 3</ls>, <ls n="tantravārttika">6. 3. 34. 7</ls>).
